title: The Puncture Looks Repairable Until the Tire Comes Off
topic: Driving a tire low or flat can create hidden internal damage that changes repairability
mechanicTruth: A puncture can be in an otherwise repairable tread location yet the tire can still be unsuitable for repair if low-pressure or flat operation damaged the inner liner or internal structure; internal inspection requires dismounting.
